payload.comment: Preprocessing stage is internally consistent. All arithmetic verified: class counts sum to official split sizes (89996/10004/7180); imbalance ratios (1.634 train, 3.947 test) and test-to-train prevalence ratios are arithmetically correct; augmented_train_size 359984 = 89996×4. SHA-256 index hashes are consistent across dataset_manifest, split_manifest, and ingestion artefact. Normalization (standardize, train-stats-only) and augmentations (hflip/vflip/rotate90) are appropriate for orientation-invariant tissue-type labels. Cross-institutional domain shift and class-boundary ambiguity are inherent dataset properties, correctly documented. One minor reproducibility note: llm_model_digest is null in the run manifest; pinning the exact model digest would strengthen auditability of LLM-assisted
